evidence.title: feature101 - Full-stack features. Copy. Paste. Ship.

name: feature101
summary: shadcn-style registry of full-stack Next.js features — auth, payments, uploads, booking, AI — added by CLI.
description: A registry of production-ready full-stack primitives for Next.js: instead of one UI component, each feature lands as a complete vertical slice — React component, hook, Zustand store, server action and Prisma model — copied into your repo with one command. Live features are follow, subscribe, upload, booking, auth, payments and an AI assistant, built on shadcn/ui; you own every line and there is no runtime dependency.
contains: 7 live primitives: follow, subscribe, upload, booking, auth, payments, AI assistant
each feature is a component, hook, Zustand store, server action and Prisma model
103+ files across all features, about 30 seconds per install
free primitives plus Pro at $19/year or $49 lifetime
built on shadcn/ui, Better Auth, Dodo Payments, UploadThing and Groq
